description: Add tests for the dispatcher module (models, retry, task_queue) - 103 lines at 0% coverage. Pure data models and algorithms with no external dependencies - easiest to test first.
steps: Test TaskPriority enum ordering (CRITICAL < HIGH < NORMAL < LOW < BACKGROUND)
Test TaskPayload default creation (auto-generated id, default status=PENDING, default attempt=0)
Test calculate_delay function: verify exponential backoff (attempt 0, 1, 2, 3), verify delay never exceeds max_delay_seconds, verify jitter adds randomness
Test should_retry function: returns True when attempt < max_attempts, returns False when attempt >= max_attempts

Test PriorityTaskQueue: put and get single item, put multiple items and verify priority ordering (lower priority number comes first), verify FIFO for same-priority items (earlier created_at first), test empty() and qsize() methods, test drain() returns all items in order
findings: All 31 tests pass. Coverage: models.py 100%, retry.py 100%, task_queue.py 95%, overall 98%. Lines 86-87 in task_queue.py (QueueEmpty exception handler) are unreachable in normal testing as they guard against a race condition.
